Read Synergy H1 single time point Excel export

read_synergy_endpoint.Rd

Reads an Excel export of a single time point (endpoint) measurement from a BioTek Synergy H1 plate reader and returns one row per well. Two layouts are recognised and detected automatically: the Gen5 report layout (a block of run details followed by a row of wells and a row of readings) and a plain 8 by 12 grid with column numbers across the top and row letters down the side. Every sheet in the file is read.

Usage

read_synergy_endpoint(path)

Arguments

path

Path to the xlsx file.

Value

A tibble with columns plate_id, well (zero-padded, such as "A01"), od and wavelength_nm. plate_id is taken from the sheet name when it starts with Plate (for example "Plate 19 - Sheet1" gives "Plate 19"), otherwise the file name without its extension is used. wavelength_nm is NA if the file does not record it.

Details

For time course exports use read_synergy_xlsx().

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "synergy_endpoint_example.xlsx", package = "plateReadeR")
read_synergy_endpoint(f)
#> # A tibble: 96 × 4
#>    plate_id                 well     od wavelength_nm
#>    <chr>                    <chr> <dbl>         <dbl>
#>  1 synergy_endpoint_example A01   0.406           590
#>  2 synergy_endpoint_example B01   0.249           590
#>  3 synergy_endpoint_example C01   0.166           590
#>  4 synergy_endpoint_example D01   0.13            590
#>  5 synergy_endpoint_example E01   0.103           590
#>  6 synergy_endpoint_example F01   0.318           590
#>  7 synergy_endpoint_example G01   0.244           590
#>  8 synergy_endpoint_example H01   0.273           590
#>  9 synergy_endpoint_example A02   0.266           590
#> 10 synergy_endpoint_example B02   0.112           590
#> # ℹ 86 more rows
